title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.
tldr: This paper proposes a model-agnostic framework that lets frozen LLMs and VLMs learn from deployment experience via three external components: a reasoning Skill, a Knowledge Memory for reliable facts, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base for visual examples, with a validation strategy to avoid regression. It reports consistent improvements across medical and non-medical benchmarks and transfers across multiple base models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个模型无关的框架，使冻结的大语言模型和视觉-语言模型通过三种外部经验（推理技能、知识记忆、多模态知识库）在部署后持续学习，并利用验证策略避免性能退化；在多个医学及非医学基准上显著提升，且可迁移到其他模型。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在部署后通常被冻结，因此无法从它们所解决的案例中学习。这在医学领域尤其令人担忧，因为新的临床证据、更新的指南和新疗法都可能改变既定的实践。微调可以更新模型，但需要访问模型权重并进行额外训练。无参数方法避免了训练，但它们可能过拟合固定的验证集、缺乏可靠的领域知识，或因仅将经验保存为文本而丢失视觉细节。为解决这些局限，我们提出了一个与模型无关的框架，使冻结的LLMs和VLMs能够通过三种形式的外部经验从部署中学习：一种指导推理和工具使用的技能（Skill）、一种存储由早期案例或可信外部证据支持的可信事实的知识记忆（Knowledge Memory），以及一种保存视觉示例并引导模型将每个检索到的案例与当前图像关联的多模态知识库（Multimodal Knowledge Base）。我们不依赖固定的验证集，而是采用一种验证策略，仅当更新有助于处理新案例且不会降低早期案例的性能时才保留该更新。在涵盖临床诊断、临床工作流程、医学推理以及医学和非医学视觉推理的六个基准测试中，使用四种开放权重和闭源基础模型，我们的框架在在线部署期间相较于基础模型在医学任务上的性能提升了高达34.2%，能够泛化到未见过的案例，无需进一步优化即可迁移到其他模型，并且适用于非医学领域。

title: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
summary: World models can enable autonomous ultrasound scanning by predicting the outcomes of probe motions from local observations. Learning this action--observation relationship typically relies on synchronized video--pose pairs, which are costly to collect at scale and largely unavailable in routine clinical recordings. Reliable action following further requires modeling ultrasound's cross-sectional sampling geometry. We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations. Starting from clinical videos, we adapt a video foundation model into an ultrasound generator conditioned on reference images and anatomical masks. Anatomical masks sampled along programmable trajectories through 3D anatomy provide spatial guidance for synthesizing action--video pairs. We then use these synthetic pairs to self-distill the generator into a world model that predicts future observations from local observations and actions, without requiring anatomical masks or other 3D assets at inference time. To further improve action following, we introduce the Acoustic Sampling Map (AsMap), which represents probe poses and imaging settings as pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths. Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29\% and 38\%, respectively, compared with visual servoing. Project Page: https://ultraworld-project.github.io/.
tldr: UltraWorld introduces a self-distillation framework that learns interactive ultrasound world models from untracked clinical videos, using synthetic action-video pairs and an Acoustic Sampling Map to improve action following for autonomous ultrasound scanning without real probe-pose annotations.
tldr_zh: UltraWorld 提出了一种自蒸馏框架，从无追踪的临床超声视频中学习交互式超声世界模型，通过合成动作-视频对和声学采样图来提升自主超声扫描中的动作跟随能力，而无需真实探头位姿标注。
summary_zh:
摘要：
世界模型可以通过局部观测预测探头运动的结果，从而支持自主超声扫描。学习这种动作-观测关系通常依赖于同步的视频-姿态对，这类数据在大规模采集时成本高昂，且在常规临床记录中基本不可用。可靠的动作跟随还进一步需要对超声的横截面采样几何进行建模。我们提出了UltraWorld，一种自蒸馏方法，无需真实动作标注即可将临床超声视频中的先验知识迁移到交互式世界模型中。从临床视频出发，我们将视频基础模型适配为以参考图像和解剖掩膜为条件的超声生成器。沿可编程轨迹在三维解剖结构上采样的解剖掩膜，为合成动作-视频对提供空间引导。随后，我们利用这些合成对将生成器自蒸馏为世界模型，该模型可从局部观测和动作预测未来观测，且在推理时无需解剖掩膜或其他三维资产。为进一步改善动作跟随，我们引入了声学采样图（AsMap），它将探头姿态和成像设置表示为逐像素的三维采样位置、波束方向和深度。实验表明，预测保真度和动作跟随均得到改善。在九个模拟闭环局部规划回合中，与视觉伺服相比，UltraWorld将平均最终距离误差和方向误差分别降低了29%和38%。项目页面：https://ultraworld-project.github.io/。

title: Multi-Objective Aligned Small Language Model Framework for SUD Patient Dialogue Generation
summary: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) counseling requires patient responses that reflect underlying cognitive states such as beliefs, coping strategies, and readiness for change. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent text, they often fail to produce cognitively coherent and clinically realistic patient behavior, especially under ethical and data-scarce clinical settings. Moreover, deploying frontier-scale LLMs in healthcare applications presents practical challenges including high computational cost, latency, privacy concerns, and limited deployability in resource-constrained environments, motivating the need for cognitively aligned small language models (SLMs). We propose a cognitively grounded framework for SUD patient dialogue generation that explicitly models and aligns latent cognitive components with patient histories and counselor questions. Our pipeline consists of two stages: cognitive component detection and cognitive component-aligned dialogue generation. To enable effective learning with smaller models, we combine knowledge distillation from high-capacity teacher models, preference optimization from human-annotations, and attention-guided reward shaping. Extensive evaluations using automatic scores like BERTScore, ROUGE, METEOR and BLEU, and LLM-as-judge hit-metrics against both human and teacher-model references show that cognitively informed fine-tuning substantially improves cognitive realization and alignment over a generic instruction-tuned baselines and mental health domain specific SLMs, with particularly strong gains for open-ended cognitive components.
tldr: Proposes a two-stage small language model framework for generating cognitively aligned substance use disorder patient dialogue, using cognitive component detection, knowledge distillation, preference optimization, and attention-guided reward shaping to improve clinical realism in resource-constrained settings.
tldr_zh: 提出一种两阶段小语言模型框架，用于生成具有认知一致性的物质使用障碍患者对话；结合认知成分检测、知识蒸馏、偏好优化和注意力引导奖励塑造，提升小型模型的临床真实感与部署可行性。
summary_zh: 物质使用障碍（SUD）咨询需要患者做出反映潜在认知状态（如信念、应对策略和改变准备度）的回应。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）能够生成流畅的文本，但它们往往难以产生认知连贯且临床真实感的患者行为，尤其是在伦理约束和临床数据稀缺的环境下。此外，在前沿规模的LLMs部署于医疗应用时面临实际挑战，包括高计算成本、延迟、隐私问题以及在资源受限环境中部署能力有限，这促使了对认知对齐的小型语言模型（SLMs）的需求。我们提出了一种基于认知框架的SUD患者对话生成方法，该方法明确地对潜在认知成分进行建模，并将其与患者病史和咨询师问题对齐。我们的流程包括两个阶段：认知成分检测和认知成分对齐的对话生成。为了利用较小的模型实现有效学习，我们结合了高容量教师模型的知识蒸馏、基于人工标注的偏好优化以及注意力引导的奖励塑形。使用BERTScore、ROUGE、METEOR和BLEU等自动评分指标，以及以LLM作为评判者对人类和教师模型参考的命中指标进行的大量评估表明，认知信息微调在认知实现和对齐方面显著优于通用指令微调基线及心理健康领域的专用SLMs，尤其在开放式认知成分上取得了更强增益。

title: Gradient-Based Trajectory Optimisation over Continuous Poses for Sparse-View Cone-Beam CT
summary: Trajectory optimisation for cone-beam computed tomography (CT) determines which information sparse-view scans acquire. Fixed candidate pools prevent off-grid refinement and require new object-specific precomputation for each acquisition manifold. We make every source pose an individual continuous variable and move all poses jointly by gradient ascent on the scanner's kinematic manifold. The objective combines soft-Tuy plane coverage, continuous View Covariance Loss, and an analytic attenuation-aware ray-bundle penalty. The same optimiser handles circular, limited C-arm, two-axis, and freesphere parametrisations. On a Defrise flange, continuous selection recovers laminar defects invisible to a circular orbit, matches discrete swap search on the free sphere at the sparser budget, and leads at the denser one, with the same objective evaluated in every arm. A moderate elevation band already recovers most of the free-sphere gain at the defects, so the same optimiser transfers to bounded scanner envelopes. Photon noise preserves the ordering on the flange and compresses it on a dense fuel nozzle. Sparseprescan planning benefits from matching prescan and planned acquisition manifolds. Selection takes seconds rather than minutes without an object-specific reconstruction basis. Prescan-planned poses were executed on a robot CT bench and reconstructed in a common frame, demonstrating feasibility but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling. Continuous pose optimisation incorporates attenuation and scanner constraints directly into sparse-view acquisition design.
tldr: This paper proposes a gradient-based method that optimizes continuous source poses for sparse-view cone-beam CT trajectory planning, unifying multiple scanner geometries and incorporating attenuation and scanner constraints directly into acquisition design. Experiments show feasibility on phantom and robot CT setups, with faster planning but no consistent metric gain over uniform band sampling.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种在连续源位姿空间上进行梯度优化的稀疏视图锥束CT扫描轨迹规划方法，可统一处理多种扫描几何约束，并将衰减与扫描仪约束直接纳入采集设计。体模与机器人CT实验表明其可行且规划速度快，但相比均匀带状采样未见一致性的指标提升。
summary_zh: 摘要：锥束CT的轨迹优化决定了稀疏扫描采集哪些信息。固定候选池无法进行离网格优化，且每个采集流形都需要重新进行对象特定的预计算。我们将每个源位姿视为独立的连续变量，并通过在扫描仪运动学流形上的梯度上升联合移动所有位姿。目标函数结合了软Tuy平面覆盖、连续视角协方差损失和解析的衰减感知射线束惩罚。同一优化器可处理圆形、有限C臂、双轴和自由球参数化。在Defrise法兰上，连续选择恢复了圆形轨迹不可见的层状缺陷，在更稀疏的视角预算下与自由球上的离散交换搜索相匹配，并在更密集的预算下领先，且每个方案中使用的目标函数相同。适度的仰角带已能恢复缺陷处的大部分自由球增益，因此同一优化器可迁移到受限扫描仪包络。光子噪声在法兰上保持了这种排序，并在密集燃料喷嘴上压缩了该排序。稀疏预扫描规划得益于匹配预扫描与计划采集流形。选择过程只需数秒而非数分钟，且无需对象特定的重建基。预扫描规划的位姿已在机器人CT实验台上执行，并在公共坐标系中重建，证明了其可行性，但与均匀带采样相比没有一致的度量增益。连续位姿优化将衰减和扫描仪约束直接纳入稀疏扫描采集设计中。

title: Coverage-Aware Reasoning with Medical Tokens for Diagnosis Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising potential for next-visit diagnosis prediction, owing to their ability to integrate longitudinal clinical evidence and reason over it in natural language. However, reinforcement learning for LLM reasoning commonly rewards each trajectory according to the correctness of its final answer. In next-visit diagnosis prediction, multiple diagnoses can be simultaneously valid, but independently rewarding one diagnosis per trajectory does not distinguish repeated hits from coverage of different diagnoses. The policy can therefore concentrate on a few correct diagnoses, leaving others uncovered. Meanwhile, LLM tokenizers can split ICD codes into several generic tokens with limited clinical meaning, requiring multiple decoding steps to predict each diagnosis and hindering reasoning over a large disease vocabulary. To address both challenges, we propose CARing, a framework that represents diagnoses with compositional Semantic IDs (SIDs) and optimizes reasoning trajectories for multi-label coverage. Concretely, we first encode ontology-enriched disease semantics into compact SIDs through residual quantization, and ground the resulting SID tokens in natural language and longitudinal EHR contexts through multi-task alignment and reasoning-enriched training to unlock transferable LLM reasoning. CARing further improves unordered multi-label prediction through a coverage reward for reinforcement learning and multi-positive supervision. At inference time, the model supports both efficient direct constrained decoding and multi-chain reasoning with rank fusion. On MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, CARing exceeds all EHR-trained baselines in weighted F1 and attains the highest top-k recall at every reported cutoff, including R@30 of 46.04% and 46.52% in reasoning mode. Our codes and logs are available at https://github.com/zmlxzyh/CARing-Codes-Logs.
tldr: CARing improves LLM-based next-visit diagnosis prediction by encoding disease ontology into compact semantic IDs and using coverage-aware reinforcement learning with multi-positive supervision to avoid repeated hits while improving multi-label coverage, achieving strong results on MIMIC-III/IV.
tldr_zh: CARing 通过将疾病本体编码为紧凑语义ID，并采用覆盖感知强化学习与多正例监督，改进基于大语言模型的下一就诊诊断预测，避免重复命中并提升多标签覆盖，在MIMIC-III/IV上取得较强结果。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）凭借其整合纵向临床证据并以自然语言进行推理的能力，为下访诊断预测带来了广阔前景。然而，用于LLM推理的强化学习通常根据每条轨迹最终答案的正确性来给予奖励。在下访诊断预测中，多个诊断可以同时成立，但每条轨迹仅对单个诊断进行独立奖励，无法区分重复命中与不同诊断的覆盖。因此，策略可能集中于少数正确诊断，而遗漏其他诊断。与此同时，LLM分词器可能将ICD代码拆分为若干缺乏临床意义的通用词元，导致预测每个诊断需要多次解码步骤，并阻碍在大型疾病词汇表上的推理。为应对这两项挑战，我们提出了CARing框架，该框架使用组合式语义ID（SIDs）表示诊断，并针对多标签覆盖优化推理轨迹。具体而言，我们首先通过残差量化将富含本体论的疾病语义编码为紧凑的SID，并通过多任务对齐和推理增强训练将所得SID词元锚定到自然语言和纵向EHR上下文中，以解锁可迁移的LLM推理能力。CARing还通过用于强化学习的覆盖奖励和多正例监督，进一步改进无序多标签预测。在推理时，该模型既支持高效的直接约束解码，也支持带排序融合的多链推理。在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，CARing在加权F1上超过所有基于EHR训练的基线，并在每个报告的截断点取得最高top-k召回率，其中推理模式下的R@30分别达到46.04%和46.52%。我们的代码和日志可在 https://github.com/zmlxzyh/CARing-Codes-Logs 获取。
